Windsor Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Jpmorgan Chase & Co Com (JPM) by 123.77% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Windsor Capital Management Llc bought 6,644 shares as the company’s stock rose 0.67% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 12,012 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.28M, up from 5,368 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Windsor Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Jpmorgan Chase & Co Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $386.17B market cap company.
